verdict.rationale: Pendo's Data Sync is a first-party export to Snowflake, S3, Azure or Google Cloud storage, which gives a real bulk-export path for analytics data (pendo-docs-6, pendo-docs-7). The evidence does not name the file formats, and it does not show that all data types (session replays, guides, feedback, configuration) can be exported for offboarding. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON), confirmation that export covers all data types, documented offboarding/exit process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
